records.title: Rare pulmonary barotrauma after explosive decompression: a case report
records.locator: Background, Equipment and profiles, and Case presentation, pp. 2–4
records.evidence_note: The authors identify one first observed pulmonary barotrauma among 566 rapid decompressions in a single-occupant chamber. The CT documented bilateral pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum. The report gives no exact surveillance dates, systematic case ascertainment protocol or DCS case count.

observations.group: Trainees in the two explosive-decompression profiles
observations.note: The case occurred in the 391-run lower-altitude profile. The denominator in this row covers both profiles and the source reports no DCS incidence.

note: Checked the 2008 author abstract, the 2003 curriculum, and the 1992 literature review. Identified the 2001 proceedings paper by its paper and accession numbers. Only catalogue metadata for the 2001 paper was retrieved.
